programme.title: Information and Communication Engineering (ICE), Bachelor of Engineering (International Program), International School of Engineering (ISE), Faculty of Engineering
programme.campus: Main campus, Pathum Wan, Bangkok (Building 2, Faculty of Engineering, Bangkok 10330)
programme.quote: The Information and Communication Engineering program is an international program focused on developing world-class graduates with leadership potential at national, regional, and international levels.
programme.language_quote: ISE is the international school within the Faculty of Engineering at Chulalongkorn University — English-taught degrees across robotics, intelligent systems, nano-engineering, aerospace and more.
programme.how_found: CEDT (Computer Engineering and Digital Technology, Sandbox programme, Dept. of Computer Engineering) was checked first: the official Faculty of Engineering notice (https://www.eng.chula.ac.th/th/43678) shows it admits through Thai TCAS rounds (tcas.atc.chula.ac.th) and no international/foreign-applicant admission route or English-medium statement was found on official pages; cp.eng.chula.ac.th reset connections. Therefore the closest English-taught computer-engineering bachelor open to non-Thai applicants was chosen: ICE at ISE, found via ise.eng.chula.ac.th home navigation and sitemap.xml.

english.quote: Test Minimum Score TOEFL (iBT) ≥ 80 IELTS ≥ 6.0 CU–TEP ≥ 80 Duolingo English Test ≥ 105
english.how_found: ISE Prospective Students > International page, 'ISE Admission Criteria — Academic Year 2027', section 1.2 English Test.
english.notes: Applies to non-Thai applicants for AY2027, both Option 1 (Test Scores) and Option 2 (Portfolio); English weight 20%. Scores must be within two years before application. Applicants with ≥2 years at an English-medium international school may use the equivalent passing score.

value.description: AY2027 international admission, two options. Option 1 (Test Scores): GPAX not required as a threshold (7.5% weight); requires English plus maths (e.g. SAT Math ≥620, CU-AAT Math ≥480, ACT Math ≥26) and science (e.g. CU-ATS Physics ≥400, ACT Science ≥25) minimums; interview pass/fail. Option 2 (Portfolio): GPAX ≥3.25 (Grade 12 or equivalence), English 20%, portfolio 35%, interview 15%.
value.value: Option 1: no GPAX minimum, SAT Math ≥ 620 or CU-AAT Math ≥ 480 (or ACT Math ≥ 26); Option 2: GPAX ≥ 3.25

gpa.quote_3: 2.1 Option 1 — Test Scores Component Weight GPAX (Grade 12 or equivalence) 7.5% English Test 20% Mathematics Test 32.5% Science Test 40% Interview Pass/Fail Total 100%
gpa.how_found: Same AY2027 international criteria page, sections 1.1, 1.3, 1.4 and 2.
gpa.notes: A Kazakhstan NIS Grade 12 diploma needs a high-school equivalency certificate via the Chula High School Certificate Equivalency System (hsces.atc.chula.ac.th) per the AY2026 announcement page link; GPAX on a 4.0 scale is expected for Option 2. Admission is a weighted composite, not a single cut-off.

scholarship_exists.quote: Announcement of Faculty of Engineering, Chulalongkorn University about ISE Scholarship for Foreign Students of International Admission 2026
scholarship_exists.how_found: Linked on the ISE International Admission 2026 (Foreign Students) news page; PDF announcement read (https://s3.siwatsystem.com/hdd-ise-web/public/376ed484-2329-4fe1-a355-ebce69d405e8-document_Admission_AY2026_Announcement_ISE_scholarship_foreign_students_AY_2026-1ko3ef.pdf, ISE's file host linked from the official page).
scholarship_exists.notes: PDF (scanned image, dated 8 Dec 2025): Full Scholarship covers tuition, program fees, economy round-trip ticket, monthly stipend and accommodation, health insurance for 4 years; Tuition Scholarship covers tuition + program fees and health insurance. Eligibility: non-Thai, not over 25, admitted via Option 1 or 2; must indicate intent in the admission application; maintain GPAX ≥3.00 and 80 h/semester ISE promotion work. 2027 edition not yet published. Separate ISE50/ISE100 Academic Excellence (50%/100% program fee waiver) exist for enrolled ISE students (/current-students/scholarship).
